title: Miren Runtime: Authentication bypass in RPC layer: unverified TLS client certificates grant cluster superuser access…
description: Miren Runtime versions prior to 0.11.1 contain a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in the RPC server's TLS client certificate verification. The server requests client certificates but fails to verify that they chain to the cluster's Certificate Authority. This flaw allows an attacker who can reach the RPC port (default :8443) to present a forged, self-signed certificate with a matching issuer Distinguished Name and gain cluster superuser access without valid credentials. The vulnerability enables full control over the cluster, including manipulation of entities, applications, and resources. A patch is available in version 0.11.1 that enforces proper client certificate chain verification. Until patched, restricting network access to the RPC port to trusted networks is recommended.
